# xcombine

> Independent Software Studio. Explore ready-to-use software, order a custom solution, or help shape a new product built around your industry's needs.

Canonical website: https://xcombine.xyz/
Primary page: https://xcombine.xyz/

## What we do

- CRM & Business Management: All clients, deals and tasks in one place. You can see what is happening in your business at any moment.
- AI Assistants & Chatbots: Answer common questions 24/7, collect client details and pass ready requests to your team.
- Business Process Automation: Repetitive tasks run on their own: reminders, notifications, reports and data transfer.
- Websites & Web Applications: A fast, modern website that sends client requests straight into your system.
- Custom Software Development: Software built for your exact process when ready-made tools don’t fit.
- API & System Integrations: Your tools talk to each other — no more copying data by hand between apps.

## Products

- [Rieltix](https://rieltix.com/): CRM for real estate agencies
- [Mapest](https://mapest.app/): Property search & listings platform
- [Forma](https://forma.ink/): Smart document builder with AI
